## Checklist

- [ ] Source is `diagrams/<slug>.md` (Mermaid) or `diagrams/<slug>.d2` (D2), named after the branch slug
- [ ] `./scripts/render.sh` ran clean
- [ ] Rendered SVG committed under `render/` (required for D2)
- [ ] Context section explains the diagram in 2–3 lines
